elements.requirement: Where a seller in a contract of sale is in breach of any express or implied term of the contract, the buyer is entitled to claim damages.
elements.quote: Where in a contract of sale the seller is in breach of any term of the contract (express or implied), the buyer shall be entitled— (a) to claim damages

elements.requirement: Where a seller in a contract of sale breaches any express or implied term and that breach is material, the buyer is entitled to reject any goods delivered under the contract and treat the contract as repudiated.
elements.quote: if the breach is material, to reject any goods delivered under the contract and treat it as repudiated

elements.requirement: The remedies provided to a buyer under subsection (1) do not apply to a contract governed by Chapter 2 of Part 1 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) does not apply to a contract to which Chapter 2 of Part 1 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015 applies

elements.requirement: Section 15B of the Sale of Goods Act 1979 applies exclusively to Scotland.
elements.quote: This section applies to Scotland only.
